author: Athul Prem
scope: Five 1 GHz left-incident layered solves with nominal fixed-property cubic Ge. Both uniform cases use their exact same-discrete SAFE port phase and fail the 0.01 complex-reference check. The two-hole meshes vary the x-y footprint target at fixed two z layers, ports and 48-segment holes. The 105-to-80 nm pair fails the 0.01 complex criterion. The 80-to-60 nm pair passes both 0.01 pair criteria. Comparisons with the saved tetrahedral h50 case retain their complex-response failures and serve as cross-discretization sensitivity checks. Continuum accuracy and transfer to the full 26-hole device require separate evidence.
complex_encoding: [real, imaginary] pairs; outgoing rows and incoming columns.

uniform_h105.author: Athul Prem
uniform_h105.scope: Uniform layered guide at 1 GHz with left incidence and 135-DOF SAFE ports. Each transmitted root is compared with exp(i*k*L) in the same basis, at the physical end planes.

uniform_h60.author: Athul Prem
uniform_h60.scope: Uniform layered guide at 1 GHz with left incidence and 135-DOF SAFE ports. Each transmitted root is compared with exp(i*k*L) in the same basis, at the physical end planes.

h105_to_h80.author: Athul Prem
h105_to_h80.scope: Saved runs are compared at the same reference planes after matching unit-power channels. The comparison covers one frequency and incidence side. Mesh-pair checks require distinct discretizations and passing input power-balance checks. A pass does not establish continuum accuracy or a frequency-band result.

h80_to_h60.author: Athul Prem
h80_to_h60.scope: Saved runs are compared at the same reference planes after matching unit-power channels. The comparison covers one frequency and incidence side. Mesh-pair checks require distinct discretizations and passing input power-balance checks. A pass does not establish continuum accuracy or a frequency-band result.

comparison.author: Athul Prem
comparison.scope: Offline comparison of previous tetrahedral h50 and layered h80 two-hole runs at 1 GHz. In-plane and through-thickness discretization differ. This comparison is cross-mesh sensitivity for the selected pair, with no continuum error bound.

comparison.author: Athul Prem
comparison.scope: Offline comparison of previous tetrahedral h50 and layered h60 two-hole runs at 1 GHz. In-plane and through-thickness discretization differ. This comparison is cross-mesh sensitivity for the selected pair, with no continuum error bound.

interpretation: The uniform exp(i*k*L) comparison measures deviation from the same discretized SAFE section at the physical end planes. Refining the x-y footprint also changes interior transverse resolution while the port section and the two thickness intervals stay fixed. It does not isolate axial error or establish continuum accuracy.
